purpose: Pre-migration metadata snapshot of the TARGET Supabase project, captured before applying the Phase 3 customer-centred business schema. Read-only inspection via the public anon (publishable) key; no secret credentials used.
inspection_method: PostgREST per-table GET probes with the public publishable key. HTTP 404 + PGRST205 = table absent from schema cache; HTTP 200 = table present (RLS may return an empty array). The OpenAPI root (/rest/v1/) requires a secret key and was NOT used.

profiles.note: EXISTS and UNCHANGED. RLS blocks anon reads (empty array). Authoritative applied DDL is supabase/profiles.sql. Must NOT be modified by Phase 3.

conflict_assessment: NONE. All 14 target business tables are absent. The legacy 'transactions' table is also absent, confirming the superseded 6-table migration (commit bf1e6da) was NEVER applied. The target public schema contains only 'profiles'. No destructive operation or schema conflict exists; Phase 3 is purely additive.
auth_and_profiles: auth.users and public.profiles are preserved untouched. Phase 3 adds a nullable customers.auth_user_id FK referencing auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; it does not alter auth.users, profiles, or the handle_new_user trigger.
original_qoder_database: The source Qoder-managed database (6 business tables, 17 records) is the backup and is NOT modified by Phase 3. The new business schema starts EMPTY (no import of the 17 records).

execution_path.apply_channel: User runs the ordered SQL in Supabase Dashboard -> SQL Editor (established workflow, same as profiles.sql). Agent verifies results via read-only anon REST probes and user-run validation scripts.

backup_artifacts: supabase/backup/0000_backup_metadata.sql (read-only pg_catalog export for the user to run and save BEFORE applying migrations)
